Mondo LogDef defines by setting (hospital) not by biological mechanism — not suitable for Foundation
Mondo LogDef uses ObjectUnionOf for multiple possible agents — not EL compliant
Too broad; Mondo LogDef is for the general category, not useful as Foundation equivalence
